decisions.reason: Piqué upholstery fabric is closely aligned with the core range and retains its own website page.
Flame-retardant curtain fabric supports contract projects and still has its own website page.
Semi-transparent wool bouclé leno remains a niche item without a dedicated page but its natural fiber fits sustainability goals, so we keep it under review.
New braided-structure fabric has its own page and builds on established offer, so we give it time to gain market traction.
